text:
name: remediation_data_integrity
question: >-
  Can we repair the measurement-integrity flaws documented in the 2026-08-13 architecture
  review without re-running the whole corpus — by (a) instrumenting the four still-unmeasured
  ledger fields (confidence, perturbation_strength, test_executed_success, answer/explanation
  split), (b) recomputing all derived metrics from the existing worktrees and DB, (c) re-running
  only the genuinely contaminated cells, and (d) re-admitting the gated policy arms only once
  their inputs exist?
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true
    model_pool:
      - deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
      - deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
    context:
      remediation_source: >-
        Fix plan derived from code_reviews/2026-08-13_architecture-hardening-review.md
        (P0-P2 findings, 3 conflicting pricing sources, fabricated 100% pass rate, absolute-$
        strategy thresholds, dead 2-way taxonomy, silent clean-cel…
